decisions.observation: showTaskManager is undefined; getAppMetrics returned CPU and memory field shapes.
decisions.decision: Public metrics are a candidate data primitive. A maintained first-party task-manager UI and behavior verification remain required; a placeholder does not meet the original guard capability.
Keep ordinary updater transport separate from nullable managed policy. Prior source null handling supports a policy-provider boundary, not removal of all update functionality.

decisions.observation: clone, _createWebViewAdoptionLease and setAgentActive are undefined. Public history restoration resolved and retained edited form state, but returned the initial page heap value instead of the edited live value.
decisions.decision: History restoration is a tested candidate primitive only. Live clone, view ownership, lease acceptance and lifecycle still need explicit contracts and acceptance; full equivalence is unproven.

decisions.observation: The Owl --allow-ipc flag exited 9 as an unknown option. With --permission, both has(net) and has(ipc) returned false while owned TCP loopback and Unix socket round trips succeeded.
decisions.decision: Permission.has(false) does not establish transport denial in this public runtime. Preserve the original network/declared-IPC requirement; a real isolation or runtime implementation is needed. This probe does not test arbitrary remote destinations.

runtimeRouteDecision: Reject unmodified Electron 42.3.0 as a direct drop-in for the observed Owl contracts. Electron with first-party adapters remains a candidate; no full runtime route is selected or independently built.
